mapper.select: select p.id as id, p.name as name, p.lat as lat, p.lng as lng, p.merchant_id as merchantId, p.city_code as cityCode, p.cover_img as coverImg, p.address as address, p.create_time as createTime from roam_poi p where p.status = 1 and (p.application_type is null or p.application_type = 2 or (p.application_type in (1, 3) and p.audit_status = 1)) and p.lat between #{minLat} and #{maxLat} and p.lng between #{minLng} and #{maxLng} order by power(p.lat - (#{minLat} + #{maxLat}) / 2, 2) + power((p.lng - (#{minLng} + #{maxLng}) / 2) * cos(radians((#{minLat} + #{maxLat}) / 2)), 2) asc, p.id asc limit #{limit}
